answer: Before dawn the master checks his book, his stock and his stamps, in that order, and nothing leaves the yard until all three agree. Soapmaker kettle book with soapmakers attestation is the morning check that catches the cheat: seven-year book, 30,000 pounds boiled, ash accounts, monthly returns. Pass a stolen harbor at the gate and the goods are held, the carrier pays double the toll and the tide is impounded until Michaelmas, while the horizon is entered in the day book and read when the quarter closes.
